about.text: Asadero cheese is a soft cheese that melts easily. It is usually made in the shape of a round tortilla. Often mistaken for Oaxaca cheese.

sources.text: Chihuahua; curd stretched in hot whey (drier than Oaxaca); made fresh, not aged; melts well
